result.summary: The page looks generally functional, with one notable visual issue found.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is cut off mid-word (should likely be 'Trattoria Piccolo' or similar), and the card appears narrower than the others, suggesting a layout truncation issue beyond normal edge clipping — the text is clipped inside the visible card area, not at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Ensure restaurant name text within cards uses ellipsis overflow (text-overflow: ellipsis) rather than hard-clipping mid-character, so truncated names end gracefully with '...' and remain readable.
